bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 跌回 5 日均线下方，守住 $395–397

read.en: Tesla fell 1.3% on Nov 3 to $398.50, trading between $396.54 and $406.49. It is just below the rising 5-day ($401.9) and above the rising 10-day ($394.2), 30-day ($377.9) and 100-day ($368.1) and the falling 200-day ($384.9). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 26 and above zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 21 ($378.64), and RSI is 59.
read.zh: 特斯拉 11月3日下跌 1.3%，收于 $398.50，盘中区间 $396.54–406.49。股价略低于上行的 5 日均线（$401.9），并位于上行的 10 日（$394.2）、30 日（$377.9）和 100 日均线（$368.1）以及下行的 200 日均线（$384.9）上方。MACD 自 10月26日起位于信号线上方且在零轴之上，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月21日起看多（$378.64），RSI 为 59。

read.en: The close slipped back under the 5-day and the $401.3–404.2 area, while the $396.5 low held the $395.3–397.6 support. Resistance is $401.9–406.5 (5-day, Oct 28 close, Nov 3 high), then $409.3–414.2 and $416.4–420.3. Support is $394.2–397.6 (10-day, Oct 27–28 and Nov 2–3 lows), then $384.9–388 ($388 cap, 200-day, Oct 30 low) and $377.9–378.6. A close above $406.5 would target $409–414; below $394, $388.

r.en: Apr 17 high $409.3; Oct 28 high $410.85; Nov 2 high $414.2

s.en: $388 cap since March; 200-day average $384.9; Oct 30 low $387.5
